The Physical Therapy Place is a locally owned private practice in Anchorage Alaska, founded in 2000. Joy Backstrum and Katie Piraino began the practice with the vision to provide the highest quality physical therapy in a caring, patient-focused environment. Joy and Katie have many years of experience as physical therapists and have both successfully completed an orthopedic residency. The Physical Therapy Place is also the only Postural Restoration Certified™ clinic in the the state of Alaska.
 
We specialize in orthopedics and pelvic health. 

The aim of our practice is to promote healing, restore normal function and improve quality of life. It is our goal to empower each patient to be healthy and perform at their optimum level. This is done through education, exercise and hands-on treatment.
